description: This Java class defines an immutable entry object named ExistentEntry which holds a value and a revision number. It implements the Entry interface and provides methods for access, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: ExistentEntry
classes.description: An immutable class representing an entry with a revision number and a value.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Indicates that the entry exists, always returns true.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on revision and value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on revision and value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.
